text: Debugging is an essential skill for any programmer. When your code doesn't work as expected, the first step is identifying bugs. This means finding out where and why the problem happens. Fortunately, there are many debugging tools that can help you, such as breakpoints and error messages. However, tools alone are not enough. You also need a systematic approach: check your code step by step, test one part at a time, and make changes carefully. Logging is another useful technique. By adding log statements to your code, you can see what is happening while the program runs. With patience and good strategies, you can solve most bugs efficiently.
